### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the business need or analytical gap is.

### Proposed Analytical Solution

### Business Value
Explain how this helps Cleopatra Modern Cosmetics stakeholders (e.g. improving promotional ROI, reducing stockout risk, increasing customer retention).
